rules.title: San Francisco Rent Ordinance annual allowable rent increase (March 2026 – February 2027)
rules.requirement: The Rent Board publishes the annual allowable rent increase under the San Francisco Rent Ordinance. For March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027 it is 1.6%. The page also lists the capital improvement imputed interest rates and uncompensated labor rates used in related petitions.

coverage.summary: Coverage is not stated on this rates page; it publishes the annual rate only.

rules.effective_date_note: Rate applies to the period March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027 and is reset annually.
rules.review_note: The page does not give a section number for the allowable increase; it is cited at chapter level. Secondary rate tables (capital improvement imputed interest and labor rates) are folded into this record.
rules.source_notes: Official SF Rent Board rate report.

rules.title: San Francisco security deposit interest rate (March 2026 – February 2027)
rules.requirement: The Rent Board publishes the interest rate on tenant security deposits. For March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027 it is 4.2%.

coverage.summary: Coverage is not stated on this rates page.

rules.effective_date_note: Rate applies to the period March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027 and is reset annually.
citation_aliases: Rent Board security deposit interest rate
rules.review_note: The page names no legal authority for the deposit interest rate. The chapter 37 citation is a placeholder because the page is published by the Rent Board. Deposit caps and return deadlines are not stated.
rules.source_notes: Official SF Rent Board rate report.

rules.title: Relocation payments for owner/relative move-in, demolition/permanent removal, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation evictions
rules.requirement: For evictions based on owner or relative move-in, demolition or permanent removal of the unit from housing use, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation, the landlord must pay relocation to each tenant. The amount depends on the date the notice of termination is served. The page ties these amounts to Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.
rules.key_value: For notices served 3/1/2026–2/28/2027: $8,245.00 per tenant; $24,733.00 maximum per unit; plus $5,497.00 for each elderly (60+) or disabled tenant or household with minor child(ren). Prior period (3/1/2025–2/28/2026): $8,062.00 / $24,184.00 / $5,375.00.

coverage.summary: Payable to tenants evicted for the listed causes; amount fixed by the date of service of the eviction notice.
coverage.other_conditions: Temporary capital improvement evictions of less than 20 days are governed by Cal. Civ. Code § 1947.9, not § 37.9C.

rules.effective_date_note: Amounts apply to notices served 3/1/2026–2/28/2027 and are reset annually.
rules.quoted_span: Relocation Payments for Evictions based on Owner/Relative Move-in OR Demolition/Permanent Removal of Unit from Housing Use OR Temporary Capital Improvement Work* OR Substantial Rehabilitation
rules.review_note: The Admin. Code prefix and chapter are inferred from the 'Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C' reference on the page. The 3/1/2025–2/28/2026 amounts are the prior period.
rules.source_notes: Official SF Rent Board rate report.

rules.title: Relocation payments for Ellis Act evictions
rules.requirement: Tenants evicted under the Ellis Act must receive relocation payments. The amount depends on the date the notice of termination is served. The page ties these amounts to Rent Ordinance Section 37.9A.
rules.key_value: For notices served 3/1/2026–2/28/2027: $11,110.05 per tenant; $33,330.13 maximum per unit; plus $7,443.90 for each elderly (62+) or disabled tenant. Prior period (3/1/2025–2/28/2026): $10,863.45 / $32,590.33 / $7,278.67.

coverage.summary: Applies to tenants evicted under the Ellis Act.

rules.effective_date_note: Amounts apply to notices served 3/1/2026–2/28/2027 and are reset annually.
rules.quoted_span: Relocation payments for tenants evicted under the Ellis Act
rules.review_note: The Admin. Code prefix is inferred from the page's 'Multilingual Relocation Payments 37.9A' link label.
rules.source_notes: Official SF Rent Board rate report.

rules.title: Relocation payments for temporary displacement of less than 20 days (Cal. Civ. Code § 1947.9)
rules.requirement: For temporary capital improvement evictions lasting less than 20 days, relocation is governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9, not Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C. The Rent Board lists a per-day payment per tenant household plus actual moving expenses.
rules.key_value: For notices served 3/1/2026–2/28/2027: $446.00/day per tenant household plus actual moving expenses (prior: $436.00/day for 3/1/2025–2/28/2026).

coverage.summary: Temporary displacement of less than 20 days for capital improvement work.

rules.effective_date_note: Dollar rate applies to notices served 3/1/2026–2/28/2027.
rules.quoted_span: The amount of relocation payments for temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days is governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 and not by Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.
rules.review_note: Jurisdiction is recorded as CA because the page cites a state statute. The dollar rate is published by the SF Rent Board and the page does not state whether the statute is limited to San Francisco.
rules.source_notes: Official SF Rent Board rate report.

result.doc_summary: San Francisco Rent Board rates page for March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027. It lists the allowable annual rent increase (1.6%), security deposit interest (4.2%), capital improvement imputed interest and labor rates, Rent Board fees, and relocation payments. Relocation payments cover owner/relative move-in, demolition, capital improvement and substantial rehabilitation evictions (Rent Ordinance § 37.9C), Ellis Act evictions (§ 37.9A), and temporary displacement under 20 days (Cal. Civ. Code § 1947.9). The page gives no coverage or exemption details.
